metaDescription: Puli vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Puli boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Puli social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Puli exposure.
Weight range 25-35 lb (11-16 kg) and grooming needs (Corded coat specialist care.) belong in the same Puli household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Puli is also monitored for degenerative myelopathy risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Puli appointments.
After the Puli puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Puli misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Puli series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Puli is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Puli away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Puli due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Puli core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Puli misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Puli health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Puli adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
